[EN] Restless Rage
[ES] Furia inquieta

[EN] They've killed so many of us. Let's return the favor.
[ES] Han matado a muchos de los nuestros. Devolvamos el favor.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] My fellow warriors—behold! The horns of the demons who killed our comrades!
[ES] ¡Compañeros guerreros, contemplad! ¡Los cuernos de los demonios que mataron a nuestros camaradas!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Vulcan Horn
[ES] Cuerno de vulcan
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Crush the vulcan wastewalkers at Zaeltarazad Shrine and gather their horns to avenge fallen soldiers.
[ES] Destruye a los caminante de los páramos vulcan en el santuario de Zaeltarazad y reúne sus cuernos para vengar a los soldados caídos.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Deliver horns to Ramsleigh at Firespine Outpost.
[ES] Entrega los cuernos a Ramsleigh en Firespine Outpost.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "For the fallen!"
[ES] ¡Por los caídos!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
